title: MagicDrive: Street View Generation with Diverse 3D Geometry Control

output_modality.value: multi-camera street-view images; extended to multi-view video (7-frame clips, 16-frame at 12Hz) by fine-tuning

control_signal.value: Camera pose, road map (BEV), 3D bounding boxes and text description (for example weather, time of day)

control_mechanism.value: Cross-attention for boxes, text and camera-pose embeddings; ControlNet-like additive encoder branch for BEV road map; cross-view attention for consistency; condition dropout and classifier-free guidance

base_model.value: Latent diffusion from pre-trained Stable Diffusion v1.5, only newly added parameters trained; video variant adds ST-Attn and temporal attention

datasets.value: nuScenes, 700 scenes for training and 150 for validation; baselines BEVGen and BEVControl

metrics.value: FID for realism; BEV segmentation mIoU (CVT) and 3D detection mAP and NDS (BEVFusion) for controllability and augmentation

controllability_evidence.value: At 224x400: FID 16.20, road mIoU 61.05, vehicle mIoU 27.01 versus BEVGen 25.54, 50.20, 5.89; box-encoder ablation drops vehicle mIoU to 5.50 without Ebox

closed_loop.value: no; open-loop generation from annotations, used as data augmentation

stated_limitations.value: Night views not dark enough; cannot generate weather unseen in nuScenes such as snow; generated views only used as augmentation alongside real data

notes: Could also be read as layout/box/map conditioning; chosen as multi-condition because camera, map, boxes and text are separately encoded. BEVFusion mAP 32.88 to 35.40 with augmentation (Table 7).
